result.title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
result.description:
Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.

A frontier smart open model built for long-running agents that need to plan, reason, use tools and keep working across complex coding, research and enterprise workflows.

Up to 5x faster inference and up to 30% lower cost for agentic tasks.

Learn more: https://nvda.ws/4adiCq9

result.title: Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella's Conversation at Microsoft Build
result.description: At Microsoft Build, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang joined Microsoft chairman and CEO Satya Nadella's keynote via livestream from Taipei to discuss the expanded partnership: NVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Station for Windows, NVIDIA GPU-accelerated Microsoft Fabric, NVIDIA open models on Microsoft Foundry, the NVIDIA OpenShell secure runtime in GitHub Copilot and the next generation of NVIDIA-powered AI factories.

result.title: Peritas AI Showcase
result.description: Peritas AI, together with NVIDIA, is bringing data intelligence into the physical world with assistive humanoid robotics and real-time AI. The first deployment is at AdventHealth, focused on surgical workflows and enhancing the patient experience.
